analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 38.1, entering oversold territory, a slight rise from 35.8 five days ago but still low. MACD histogram worsening to -0.5429, down from -0.3938 five days ago. 5-day high ($64.44) < 20-day high ($70.45) confirms Lower High pattern. Volume ratio at 0.51, indicating contraction. ADX at 28.8 shows a clear trend, but -DI (41.4) is stronger than +DI (12.7). Overall, insufficient evidence of buying pressure, hence wait-and-see.
